answer: Locks are published in vertex, expire in ripple, and summit lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 154 aliases as a result needs 109 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2019 identities would post 1729 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
